(Japanese: '''傷だらけのペルシアン''' ''The Injured Persian'') is the seventeenth chapter of the [[How I Became a Pokémon Card]] manga created by 姫野かげまる [[Kagemaru Himeno]]. The card featured in this chapter is {{TCG ID|Jungle|Persian|42}}.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
A boy discovers a wounded {{p|Persian}} and helps it recover. Although wary at first, Persian eventually bonds with the boy, who is implied to be [[Giovanni]].
